name: Kleeblatt
source:
Based on SIGNALIS.

VNovellisation of the eponymous fan fiction.

A fan-made visual novel about daily live and service of the freshly assigned comms officer at the secret radio surveillance facility Gauss-78. And about his contacts with local replica personnel (escpecially one module). And, alas, about very unfortunate timing of all of this.
translation:
基于SIGNALIS。

V同名同人小说的小说化。

一部由粉丝制作的视觉小说，讲述了秘密无线电监视设施Gauss-78中新任命的通讯官员的日常生活和服务。以及他与当地副本人员（尤其是一个模块）的联系。而且，唉，这一切发生的时机非常不幸。
